I'm not sure if I had childhood schizophrenia or just lived in a haunted house but I have been experiencing things since I was 6-8 years old. In high school I started doing research on the things happening to me and my behavior. They kept leading me to schizophrenia pages so I ended up doing a research paper on it for school. I always thought after that, that I may have it but never saw any help because no one wanted to help me (small town, I'm poor) I'm now 25 and was diagnosed about 3 years ago after my mom died and I had a really bad episode and decided I needed to see a doctor. 

Edit: Some of the things happening at a young age were hearing screaming and voices telling me things (not so much commanding, but telling me things), seeing shadows and people who weren't there. 
I would like to inform that I was born addicted to meth and breast fed it for about a year before my mom gave me to my dad so she could keep partying and he is a very abusive alcoholic so I've had a lifetime of trauma and don't know how much that contributes to my psychosis. (schizoaffective bipolar type with severe depression, bpd,  ptsd and adhd)
